description: Clone any existing ad: ingest it (URL or upload), analyze its hooks, script and scene structure, then generate your own version from one instruction (adGenerateFromPrompt). Poll adStatus; adCancel refunds an in-flight clone. Actions: adIngestUrl, adUpload, adAnalyze, adStatus, adGenerateFromPrompt, adCancel, adAssets. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
name: adgpt_recreation
title: Ad clone
